job.title: Senior Digital Product Manager E-Commerce | $15bn Revenue Company | Hamburg/Hybrid

tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional E-Commerce Specialist | Requirements Analysis, User Stories & SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Backend developer and techno-functional consultant with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Experienced in requirements engineering, translating business needs into user stories, process mapping, and coordinating cross-functional integrations across PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms. Certified in SAP Commerce Cloud development and business analysis, combining technical API depth with structured stakeholder management in international agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Digital Product Manager E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: Enterprise e-commerce delivery succeeds when business goals are rigorously translated into technical execution without communication friction. With over five years of experience engineering and consulting on large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring hands-on expertise in bridging commercial needs, complex systems, and cross-functional teams.

bullets.label: Requirements & User Stories
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders and product owners to capture business requirements, define functional specifications, write detailed user stories with acceptance criteria, and validate releases via UAT.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Led technical discovery and data flow design between SAP Commerce Cloud, PIM (Profisee), SAP ERP, and MDM systems, resolving interface bottlenecks across multi-channel B2B and B2C landscapes.

bullets.label: Platform & API Architecture
bullets.text: Architected headless commerce endpoints and OCC REST APIs supporting modern storefronts and third-party integrations, ensuring seamless catalog and order management synchronization.

bullets.label: Agile & AI-Accelerated Delivery
bullets.text: Operated across distributed agile frameworks (Scrum, PI Planning, Jira), leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate requirements mapping, edge-case documentation, and cross-system analysis.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit and am currently serving my notice period, available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my techno-functional background can drive your digital product initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: AI Futures represents an exciting intersection of cutting-edge innovation and enterprise scale for a $15bn global organisation. Driving digital commerce products in such an environment requires both functional vision and deep systems understanding. I want to leverage my hands-on background in enterprise e-commerce platforms, complex data integrations, and AI-accelerated delivery to help shape scalable digital products that deliver tangible commercial impact.
tailoring.motivation_short: Motivated to drive enterprise e-commerce product evolution by bridging complex technical integrations with clear business requirements, backed by 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce platforms for global leaders.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I noticed the Senior Digital Product Manager E-Commerce opening at AI Futures. With 5+ years delivering enterprise SAP Commerce solutions, user stories, and PIM/ERP integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would welcome the opportunity to connect and exchange ideas.
tailoring.offer: I will immediately streamline the functional translation between your business stakeholders and technical teams by delivering precise user stories and interface specifications for your e-commerce platform. Furthermore, I can audit and resolve integration bottlenecks across PIM, ERP, and commerce APIs to accelerate delivery velocity.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Digital Product Manager E-Commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Digital Product Manager E-Commerce role at AI Futures. With over five years of experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in bridging business vision and technical execution through rigorous requirements engineering, user stories, and integration mapping across PIM and ERP systems.

My techno-functional expertise and AI-assisted workflow ensure clear functional specifications and accelerated delivery for complex digital commerce platforms.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I look forward to speaking with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
